🧠 Crypto News Brief: Binance's record $6.3B hack still dominates: Washington weighs in, investigators point at North Korea and ETF money heads for the exits, while Bitcoin clings to $77K in a fearful market. 🏛️ Trump Says His Administration Is Looking Into the Binance Hack Speaking at a Friday press conference, President Trump said officials are reviewing the $6.3 billion Binance breach, noting the exchange has promised to make customers whole. The incident is fueling fresh calls for federal crypto legislation, with Sen. Lummis arguing the stalled Clarity Act would have given firms legal cover to freeze suspicious transfers quickly. Read full story 🔐 Binance Moves to Restore Confidence as $3B Is Frozen Binance pledged to cover all losses from company funds and plans to reopen withdrawals in phases within days, with a proof-of-reserves snapshot due by Monday. About $3 billion of the stolen assets has been located and frozen; Tether locked nearly $1.57 billion in USDT, Circle more than $800 million in USDC, and the U.S. Secret Service says it is working with Circle to trace and recover funds. More details 🇰🇵 Investigators Tie the $6.3B Heist to North Korea's TraderTraitor TRM Labs attributed the attack with high confidence to TraderTraitor, the Lazarus-linked North Korean unit behind the 2025 Bybit theft, and Chainalysis CEO Jonathan Levin reached the same view. TRM says roughly $6.36 billion left Binance wallets across ten blockchains, mostly within about 20 minutes. Binance itself has not named a culprit. Read more ⚖️ CFTC Chair Selig: Hack Proves Offshore Exchanges Need U.S. Rules CFTC Chairman Michael Selig told CNBC the Binance breach validates the agency's October proposals, which would offer offshore venues a voluntary federal registration path with U.S.-grade cybersecurity standards. He added that blockchain transparency gives investigators a good chance of tracing the stolen funds. See details 📉 Spot Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $643M as Hack Fears Spread U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $643.33 million in net outflows on October 30, per SoSoValue, erasing a four-day inflow streak. BlackRock's IBIT led redemptions with about $234 million, and Bitcoin is on track for a rare second consecutive losing October. Read full story 💵 Tether Posts $1.5B Q3 Profit, Reserve Buffer Nearly Doubles Tether's BDO-prepared Q3 attestation shows $1.5 billion in quarterl
